protocol.sampling: Uniform sample of row IDs without replacement, independent of features, treatment and outcomes. Index-only partition before loading sampled rows. No identity deduplication invented from hashed feature equality.
protocol.secondary_outcome: conversion; no selection/tuning based on it
protocol.action: treatment assignment, 0=no Criteo targeting, 1=eligible for personalized Criteo advertising
protocol.preprocessing: Fit-only median imputation and standard scaling continuous; most-frequent imputation and sparse one-hot categorical min_frequency=200 max_categories=64 handle_unknown=infrequent_if_exist. No target encoding or class weighting.
protocol.estimator: LogisticRegression solver=lbfgs max_iter=300 random_state=20261104; S adds action as a feature without interactions; T has separate response models

inner_cv.stratify: joint treatment and visit on training subset only

protocol.tuning: Maximum mean inner Qini-defined-below; tie by candidate order. Fit preprocessing inside each inner fit and independently within each T arm.
protocol.model_selection: Maximum Qini on selection_validation after inner-CV tuning; deterministic tie by model order S then T. No refit on validation; final candidate pipeline remains trained on train partition.
protocol.propensity_scope: Published common ratio in corrected benchmark, assumed by benchmark evaluation only; not inferred as valid for original population after selection

metrics.AUUC: trapezoidal integral of U(q), endpoints included

protocol.ranking_ties: Secondary key is a deterministic row-ID hash, independent of outcomes/actions
protocol.policy: Fixed batch capacity 20%; target top 20% by selected model visit uplift score, independent of heldout outcomes; no per-person optimality claim
baseline_policies: response_20pct using model predicted treated response
baseline_models: constant per-arm response means fitted on train only
protocol.policy_value: HT benchmark V(pi)=mean[Y*(I(T=1)*pi/e + I(T=0)*(1-pi)/(1-e))]; gain vs expected random_20pct primary
protocol.uncertainty: Paired row bootstrap 400 replicates seed=62061104, percentile 95% CI for policy gains and Qini; rerank each bootstrap sample using frozen scores and row hashes, no model/policy reselection. IID benchmark assumption only; no clustering identity available.
protocol.sensitivity: Fixed policy scores: capacity 10%,20%,30% and evaluation weights e=.80,.85,.90. Descriptive sensitivity only, cannot choose policy from final outcomes; does not identify unknown label-selection mechanism.
protocol.success: Exploratory benchmark improvement only if primary visit policy gain vs expected random20 has lower paired 95% CI >0 AND Qini lower CI >0; all other comparisons secondary. Still not production validation or original-population causal evidence.
protocol.preflight: No separate score-based feasibility model; memory/time recorded on first inner fit. Abort for resource/convergence failure, never silently change grid/protocol.
protocol.provenance_warning: Full-release aggregate counts seen only for Phase4B4 feasibility; individual final rows/outcomes are not used for training or selection. Not a prospectively collected external holdout.

SciPy ignores this legacy print option; no estimator/grid/metric/split/seed changed. Other warnings, including convergence, stop run.
